citations.quote: The portal facilitates processing of applications along with tracking of subsidy status by beneficiaries.

EWS: Annual Household Income up to Rs 3,00,000; house sizes upto 30 sq.m; LIG: Annual Household Income from Rs 3,00,001 to Rs 6,00,000; house sizes upto 60 sq.m; MIG I: Annual Household Income from Rs 6,00,001 to Rs 12,00,000; house sizes u
All eligible beneficiaries under all components of the scheme should have an Aadhaar/ Aadhaar Virtual ID.
Self-Certificate / Affidavit as Proof of Income.
Identity and Residential Proof (PAN card, Voter ID, Driving License)
Individuals availing loans to buy residential property or land or to construct homes would be eligible for interest subsidies on the said credit.
The details to be filled include name, contact number, other personal details, bank account and income details, among others.
